_doc: Vọng Triều Đường signature items (rules-proposals R7; design/items record). Prefix vtd-. Element-free hall: the items follow the soul-song-seal and general catalogues' grade 3-4 lamps and seals. Unpriced proposals.

items.name: Unsleeping Lamp (Bất Miên Đăng)

effects.name: The Lamp That Is Not Out (Đăng Vị Tức)
effects.rule: While the lamp is lit beside the holder, her ward seals last 4 s longer, and the first seal of hers to burn out each fight relights once.

items.lore: A bronze storm lamp with a wick of twisted pearl-diver's line, lit by Ôn Thủ Đăng in the winter of 913 and never let go out since. He carries it from tower to tower. The hall believes it was the founder's; it was not. He made it the night Kim Sa Trấn drowned (V171).
items.build_use: The head's ward lamp: longer seals, one relit, and a steady soul.

items.name: Breakwater Seal (Phá Lãng Ấn)
items.lore: A square seal of black basalt from the Thạch Cơ shore, cut by Chân Định Lan for the storm wards she wants the hall to build instead of watching for sails. She used it on the palace's jetty at Thạch Cơ Thành in 1190, alone and at night, and the jetty cracked anyway (A312).
items.build_use: The storm elder's seal: stronger seals and wards.

items.name: Seal of the Kim Sa Lamp (Kim Sa Ấn)
items.lore: The keeper's seal of the Kim Sa tower, which drowned with the town in 913 (V171). Divers brought it up in 920. Every ward seal he has laid since has its mark.
items.build_use: A line of ward seals that do not go out.

items.name: Robe of the Pearl Divers (Châu Lệ Bào)
items.lore: A dark-blue robe of the Âu Lộ Thôn kind, with pearl-diver's line for its seams. His sworn brother had one like it.
items.build_use: Holds a line through a whole night: soul defence and linh lực.
items.made_by: the weavers of Âu Lộ Thôn

items.name: Sea-Wall Shield (Hải Đê Thuẫn)
items.lore: A slab of Thạch Cơ basalt faced with the breakwater's lattice. She made it to show the hall what a sea wall would look like, and nobody looked.
items.build_use: Walls: block, guard and a body shield.

items.name: Jetty Stone (Thạch Cơ Ngọc Bội)
items.lore: A shard of the palace's jetty at Thạch Cơ Thành, from the crack the storm of 1190 opened through her wards (A312). She wears it so as not to forget.
items.build_use: A body that stands in surf.

sets.name: The Lamp Chain (Đăng Liên Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Not One Lamp Out (Bất Nhất Đăng Diệt): while you cast no escape art, your ward seals do not burn out, and each seal that turns a blow passes one more turn to the next seal in the line. If you cast an escape art, every seal burns out after 3 s.

sets.story: The lamp he lit the night Kim Sa drowned, the drowned tower's seal the divers brought up in 920, and a diver's robe like the one his sworn brother wore. The hall believes the set was the founder's. Only the seal was, and all three are about one night.

sets.name: The Breakwater (Phá Lãng Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Layered Against the Tide (Trùng Đê): each blow your shield or wards turn adds a layer that fades after 5 s, and each layer cuts the damage you take by a further 4 %. At five or more layers your next seal spends them all and lays 2 Heavy Breath on the foe, and one more for every five layers past five.

sets.story: The basalt seal, the shield she made for a wall no one built and the shard of the wall that cracked. All three are hers, and none of them is the hall's. That is the argument she has with Ôn Thủ Đăng.
